content.snl: %The main rendering component. It accepts a tree and one MacroDataDriver as its macro data source, plus optional interaction, hooks, and palette customization. It supports hover popovers, bvar-scope highlighting, block-renderer dispatch, and themeable palettes.%
content.markdown: The main rendering component. It accepts a tree and one `MacroDataDriver` as its macro data source, plus optional interaction, hooks, and palette customization. It supports hover popovers, `bvar`-scope highlighting, block-renderer dispatch, and themeable palettes.
